title: Unilever’s beauty ‘power brands’ Dove and Vaseline help drive Q3 growth
summary: Double-digit growth at Unilever’s body care brands Dove and Vaseline, as well as prestige hair care brand K18, helped drive third quarter 2026 sales as the conglomerate upgraded its full-year outlook

extraction.key_fact: 유니레버가 바디케어와 헤어케어 브랜드의 성장에 힘입어 연간 전망을 상향했다.
